info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create External Agency Supplier Agreement-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of supplier agreements with external agencies, enabling businesses to establish formal relationships with their partners. By leveraging this endpoint, organizations can efficiently manage the onboarding process of suppliers and ensure compliance with contractual requirements. Typical consumers of this API include procurement teams and financial departments seeking to streamline their supplier agreement workflows. The operation allows for the submission of necessary agreement details, ensuring that all relevant information is captured for seamless integration into existing systems.

post.summary: Create a new supplier agreement for an external agency.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new supplier agreement associated with an external agency. Ensure that all required fields are properly filled out in the request body to successfully create the agreement.
